How the board is ranked

Implied value = max(TVL × category multiple, annualized revenue × 7.91), with the revenue lift capped at 3× the TVL value. The category multiple is the median mcap/TVL of tokenized protocols in the same category (at least 5 comparables, else the global median 0.2683). A launch is never guaranteed — every farm plan says so. See dossier.json for the full methodology.
